azureLogAnalytics.query:
let fallimenti = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-sender'
| where SeverityLevel == 3
| where Message startswith "Error sending Rtp to be sent:"
| extend _err = trim(" ", replace_string(Message, "Error sending Rtp to be sent:", ""))
| extend Categoria = case(
    _err contains "payer is not activated",                 "⚠️ Payer non attivato",
    _err contains "rejected" or _err contains "Reject",   "❌ Rejection SEPA",
    _err contains "Timeout",                               "❌ Timeout",
    _err contains "Connection" or _err contains "refused", "❌ Errore di rete",
    _err contains "MongoWrite" or _err contains "Mongo" 
        or _err contains "TooManyRequest",                 "❌ Errore DB Mongo",
    _err contains "PayeeNotFound" 
        or _err contains "ServiceProviderNotFound",       "❌ Payee/SP non trovato",
    _err contains "InvalidTransition" 
        or _err contains "InvalidStatus",                 "❌ Transizione invalida",
    "❌ Altro / non classificato"
)
| summarize Conteggio = count() by Categoria, bin(TimeGenerated, 1d);

let successi = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == 'rtp-sender'
| where SeverityLevel == 1
| where Message startswith "Rtp sent successfully with id:"
| summarize Conteggio = count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)
| extend Categoria = "✅ Successo";

let dettaglio = union fallimenti, successi;

let totaleFallimenti = toscalar(
    dettaglio
    | where Categoria startswith "❌" or Categoria startswith "⚠️"
    | summarize sum(Conteggio)
);

let totaleSuccessi = toscalar(
    dettaglio
    | where Categoria startswith "✅"
    | summarize sum(Conteggio)
);

dettaglio
| extend
    TotaleFallimenti = totaleFallimenti,
    TotaleSuccessi   = totaleSuccessi
| sort by Conteggio desc

panels.description: Percentuale dei messaggi di rifiuto esplicito inviati dal pagatore o dal PSP (vista giornaliera).

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let saveLog = AppTraces
| where TimeGenerated between (datetime_add('day', -7, $__timeFrom()) .. $__timeTo())
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message startswith "Rtp to be sent saved with id:"
| extend resource_id = tostring(Properties["resource_id"])
| where isnotempty(resource_id)
| summarize SaveSP = take_any(extract(@"service_provider:\s*(\S+)", 1, Message)) by resource_id;
let logs = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender";
let totalSent = toscalar(logs | where Message startswith "Rtp sent successfully with id:" | summarize count());
logs
| where Message has "Triggering REJECT transition for RTP" or Message has "Send RTP request rejected for"
| extend resource_id = tostring(Properties["resource_id"])
| join kind=leftouter saveLog on resource_id
| extend DebtorSP = coalesce(
    tostring(Properties["debtor_service_provider"]),
    extract(@"service_provider:\s*(\S+)", 1, Message),
    trim(" ", extract(@"Send RTP request rejected for ([^:]+):", 1, Message)),
    SaveSP,
    "N/D")
| extend TipoRifiuto = case(
    Message has "Triggering REJECT transition for RTP", "Callback (Payer/PSP)",
    Message has "Send RTP request rejected for", "Send/EPC (PSP)",
    "Altro Rifiuto")
| summarize Rifiuti = count() by TipoRifiuto, DebtorSP
| extend TotaleInviati = coalesce(totalSent, 0)
| extend RefusalRatePercentage = round(todouble(Rifiuti) * 100.0 / iff(TotaleInviati == 0, 1, TotaleInviati), 2)
| sort by Rifiuti desc

azureLogAnalytics.query:
AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-activator"
| where Message startswith "Payer activated with id:"
| extend p = todynamic(Properties)
| extend PSP = coalesce(
    tostring(p["sub_token"]),
    tostring(p["mdc.sub_token"]),
    extract(@"SubToken:\s*([^,\]]+)", 1, Message)
)
| summarize AttivazioniCompletateSuccesso = count()
    by Giorno = bin(TimeGenerated, 1d), PSP = iff(isempty(PSP), "UNKNOWN", PSP)
| order by AttivazioniCompletateSuccesso desc
| project AttivazioniCompletateSuccesso, PSP, Giorno

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let saveLog = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message startswith "Rtp to be sent saved with id:"
| extend DebtorSP = extract(@"service_provider:\s*(\S+)", 1, Message)
| project OperationId, DebtorSP;
AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message startswith "Rtp sent successfully with id:"
| join kind=inner saveLog on OperationId
| summarize ["Invii con successo"] = count()

let consumer = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-consumer";
let ingeriti = toscalar(consumer
    | where Message startswith "New GPD message received"
    | extend messageId = tostring(Properties.message_id)
    | where isnotempty(messageId)
    | summarize dcount(messageId));
let payloadsCreate = consumer
    | where Message startswith "Payload:"
    | where Message contains "operation=CREATE"
    | extend msg_id = extract(@"id=(\d+)", 1, Message)
    | where isnotempty(msg_id)
    | distinct msg_id;
let createOk = toscalar(consumer
    | where Message startswith "Message processed successfully"
    | extend msg_id = tostring(Properties.message_id)
    | join kind=inner payloadsCreate on msg_id
    | summarize dcount(msg_id));
let apim = AzureDiagnostics
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where requestUri_s contains "rtp/gpd/message"
| where httpMethod_s == "POST"
| extend statusCode = toint(httpStatus_d);
let senderOk = toscalar(apim | where statusCode == 200 | count);
let senderKo = toscalar(apim | where statusCode != 200 | count);
datatable(Ordine: int, Fase: string) [
    1, "1. Messaggi GPD ingeriti",
    2, "2. CREATE processati dal Consumer",
    3, "3. Chiamate al Sender accettate (200)",
    4, "4. Chiamate al Sender rifiutate (≠200)"
]
| extend Messaggi = case(Ordine == 1, ingeriti, Ordine == 2, createOk, Ordine == 3, senderOk, senderKo)
| extend ["% su ingeriti"] = round(100.0 * Messaggi / iff(ingeriti == 0, 1, ingeriti), 2)
| order by Ordine asc
| project Fase, Messaggi, ["% su ingeriti"]

panels.description: Come Motore di Orchestrazione SRTP, Voglio intercettare l'evento di avvenuto pagamento (Update - Pagato) e confrontare il PSP esecutore con il PSP destinatario dell'SRTP, In modo da poter classificare l'attribuzione della conversione e inviare una Request for Cancellation (RfC) se il debito è stato saldato su un canale differente.

azureLogAnalytics.query:
let Sent = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message startswith "Rtp sent successfully with id:"
| summarize sentCount = count();
let SamePspRaw = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message startswith "Successfully updated paid RTP with same psp scenario."
| extend pspBic = coalesce(extract(@"PSP BIC:\s*([^,\s}]+)", 1, Message), "unknown");
let SamePspTotal = SamePspRaw
| summarize samePspCount = count();
let OtherPsp = AppTraces
| where $__timeFilter(TimeGenerated)
| where AppRoleName == "rtp-sender"
| where Message has "Successfully updated paid RTP with different psp scenario"
| summarize otherPspCount = count();
let Summary = Sent
| extend joinKey = 1
| join kind=fullouter (SamePspTotal | extend joinKey = 1) on joinKey
| join kind=fullouter (OtherPsp | extend joinKey = 1) on joinKey
| project
    Tipo = "Totale",
    ["Totale RTP inviate"] = coalesce(sentCount, 0),
    ["Pagati tramite stesso PSP (Totale)"] = coalesce(samePspCount, 0),
    ["Pagati tramite PSP diverso"] = coalesce(otherPspCount, 0),
    ["PSP BIC"] = "",
    ["Pagati tramite stesso PSP"] = long(null);
let SamePspByBic = SamePspRaw
| summarize ["Pagati tramite stesso PSP"] = count() by ["PSP BIC"] = pspBic
| project
    Tipo = "Dettaglio PSP",
    ["Totale RTP inviate"] = long(null),
    ["Pagati tramite stesso PSP (Totale)"] = long(null),
    ["Pagati tramite PSP diverso"] = long(null),
    ["PSP BIC"],
    ["Pagati tramite stesso PSP"];
Summary
| union SamePspByBic
